newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Glendale Federal Bank.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Glendale Federal Bank.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said it raised Glendale Federal Bank to buy from neutral, restoring the stock to the recommended list.
-- cited H.F. Ahmanson and Co's bid for Great Western Financial Corp. Furman Selz said that proposed deal should lift the "price/book standard" for future thrift transactions.
-- said there are only a few thrift franchises remaining in California and Glendale Federal is an attractive franchise.
-- set a $33-$35 a share price target. Additional details were not immediately available.
